answer: A glacier-paced reputation system stops Sybil farming: a new identity starts with almost no weight, and its influence thaws only after a long, unbroken thread of verified useful work, one task at a time, with no shortcuts for bulk creation. Meanwhile auditors map the hidden karst beneath the surface — shared funding, devices, or timing patterns linking accounts — so a hundred sockpuppets fed from one source collapse into a single identity. The attacker must then pay the full slow cost for every fake, while honest agents advance steadily.
